variants.bottom_line: Bottom line: rs334 in HBB is best described as: germline disease variant. ClinVar links it to HEMOGLOBIN S. Sources disagree on some points (see conflicts). Confidence: high (multi-submitter or expert-reviewed ClinVar assertion without submitter conflict).

Bottom line: rs429358 in APOE is best described as: low-penetrance risk allele, not a fully penetrant monogenic disease variant. Its strongest reported association is with c-reactive protein measurement. Sources disagree on some points (see conflicts). Confidence: high (1396 genome-wide significant associations across 1412 studies).

Bottom line: rs7412 in APOE is best described as: trait-associated common variant without an established monogenic disease role (ClinVar also records a drug-response annotation). Its strongest reported association is with low density lipoprotein cholesterol measurement. Sources disagree on some points (see conflicts). Confidence: high (1155 genome-wide significant associations across 1137 studies).
